## Article

- Citation and DOI: Joel, S., Teper, R., & MacDonald, G. (2014). People overestimate their willingness to reject potential romantic partners by overlooking their concern for other people. *Psychological Science, 25*(12), 2233–2240. <https://doi.org/10.1177/0956797614552828>
- Data/materials repository URL: <https://osf.io/873fp/> (local copy: `ps3/Group A/Choice 1/` in the course repo)
- Part A (known case) or Part B (a classmate's project paper): **Part A**, Group A Choice 1, Study 1
- Part B only: n/a

## Target outcomes

Quoted from the Study 1 results section, as given in the provided `reproducibilityReport.Rmd`.

| # | Target outcome (quoted) | Paper value(s) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Only 10 of the 61 participants in the hypothetical condition chose to exchange contact information with the unattractive potential date (16%)." | 10 / 61, 16% |
| 2 | "In contrast, 26 of the 71 participants in the real condition chose to exchange contact information (37%)." | 26 / 71, 37% |
| 3 | "A chi-square test of independence indicated that participants were significantly less likely to reject the unattractive potential date in the real condition … X^2(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009." | χ²(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009 |

## Materials inventory

| Item | Available? | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Raw data | Partly | `Empathy Gap Study 1 data.sav` holds the 132 analysed participants only. The 18 excluded participants (15 suspicious, 3 not single) are not included. |

| Preregistration | No | Not mentioned in the paper (2014). |

## Reproduction

The agent's code, copied unchanged from `joel2014/reproducibilityReport.Rmd`. The only edit is the data path, which now points into the `joel2014/` subfolder.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(haven)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
d <- read_sav("joel2014/data/Empathy Gap Study 1 data.sav")
nrow(d) # expect 132
```

```{r}
#| label: preprocess
d_tidy <- d %>%
  select(condition, exchangeinfo) %>%
  mutate(condition = haven::as_factor(condition),
         exchangeinfo = haven::as_factor(exchangeinfo))

d_tidy %>% summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
#| label: analysis
desc <- d_tidy %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(n_total = n(),
            n_exchange = sum(exchangeinfo == "yes"),
            pct_exchange = round(100 * n_exchange / n_total)) %>%
  ungroup()
kable(desc, col.names = c("Condition", "N", "N exchanged contact info", "% exchanged"))

tab <- table(d_tidy$condition, d_tidy$exchangeinfo)
tab
chi <- chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)
chi

comparison <- tibble(
  value = c("Hypothetical: n exchanged", "Hypothetical: N", "Hypothetical: %",
            "Real: n exchanged", "Real: N", "Real: %",
            "chi-square df", "N", "chi-square", "p"),
  reported = c(10, 61, 16, 26, 71, 37, 1, 132, 6.77, .009),
  reproduced = c(desc$n_exchange[desc$condition == "hypothetical"],
                 desc$n_total[desc$condition == "hypothetical"],
                 desc$pct_exchange[desc$condition == "hypothetical"],
                 desc$n_exchange[desc$condition == "real"],
                 desc$n_total[desc$condition == "real"],
                 desc$pct_exchange[desc$condition == "real"],
                 unname(chi$parameter),
                 sum(tab),
                 round(unname(chi$statistic), 2),
                 round(chi$p.value, 3))
) %>%
  mutate(match = abs(reported - reproduced) < 1e-8)
kable(comparison)
```

## Checker's verdict

Filled in by me, not the agent. I checked the agent's numbers with a separate script and against the rendered output above.


| # | Paper value | Reproduced value | Verdict (exact / minor / major / not reproducible) | Reason for discrepancy |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 10 / 61 (16%) | 10 / 61 (16.4%) | exact | rounding |
| 2 | 26 / 71 (37%) | 26 / 71 (36.6%) | exact | rounding |
| 3 | χ²(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009 | χ²(1, N = 132) = 6.767, p = .0093 | exact |rounding |

Agent's own claim about success, and whether it was right:

The agent claimed "Reproduction successful", with every target matching exactly. After checking, agent claim was correct.


## Time

- Your time (hours): 1 hour
- Agent wall-clock time (hours): 0.02 (82 s, 11 tool calls)
- Stopped at the 4-hour cap? What remained: No. Nothing remained.

## Assessment

The agent managed to reproduce the primary results of the finding in exact manner (except for rounding). Data availability and clear data and variables labeling made reproducibility accessible with minimum human intervention. The limitations of this replication are the continuity correction wasn't stated in the paper, and performing full robustness check on the pipeline would require pre-exclusion data and analysis code to be made available.
